links.comparator_used: Llama3 with a standard prompt (model1) and with an enhanced structured prompt without retrieval (model2)
links.outcome: Physician-rated adequacy and clarity of generated patient medication instructions; critical errors
links.effect: Adequacy median (IQR) 93.0 (40.0) vs 94 (53.3) vs 100 (15.0), p = 0.001; clarity 90.0 (60.0) vs 92 (55.0) vs 95.0 (24.0), p = 0.012, for model1, model2, model3 (RAG on PIL). Enhanced prompt plus RAG reduced critical errors such as incorrect and incomplete instructions and factual inaccuracies.
links.quote: RAG introduction significantly improved instructions adequacy: median (interquartile range) 93.0 (40.0) vs. 94 (53.3) vs 100 (15.0), p = 0.001, and clarity 90.0 (60.0) vs. 92 (55.0) vs 95.0 (24.0), p = 0.012, for model1, model2, and model3 respectively.

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation and structured prompt engineering
